items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I also am a big fan of the old New Yorker humorists, Robert Benchley and S.J. Perelman.

ctx.x: I wanted to bring it up.

I actually think about writing some things because I like to do that. And the last record I did I wrote my own liner notes too and I think you would get a kick out of those. And I also am a big fan of the old New Yorker humorists, Robert Benchley and S.J. Perelman. I love to read those kind of people. And that’s kind of gone now. You don’t see that kind of writing anymore.
Have you read any of the things that are written about you?

items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 9, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I’m also a fan of the old humorists, Robert Benchley, S. J. Perelman. So I’ve been going through my S. J. Perelman books reading those.

ctx.x: Yeah. Any upside for you personally? Anything you’ve taken up as a hobby or —

Well I’ve always loved books and movies so I’m reading a lot right now. Every day I actually take an hour at least and read. And I read all kinds of things — fiction, nonfiction, and I’m also a fan of the old humorists, Robert Benchley, S. J. Perelman. So I’ve been going through my S. J. Perelman books reading those. Because they still make me laugh and Lord knows we need that. And I’m watching a lot of classic movies that I’ve had over the years that I haven’t gotten around to watch. And you know, I’ve got a…
